headline: Pavlos Marinakis: Emphasis on the middle class, SMEs, compliant taxpayers and families
summary: Government spokesperson Pavlos Marinakis announced interventions focused on the middle class, compliant taxpayers and SMEs. They precede Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis's announcements at the Thessaloniki International Fair.
why: Tax and support measures for households and small businesses affect Greek fiscal policy and domestic demand.
